description: Wire AgentConfig.thinking from user/project minion frontmatter into the actual child AgentSession, add a regression test, then validate package quality gates. This is needed so ~/.pi/agent/agents role definitions can reliably select medium/high/xhigh reasoning.

comments.text: Added child-session wiring for AgentConfig.thinking and a regression test that captures the thinking level at prompt invocation. Global role definitions created under ~/.pi/agent/agents for debugger, general-coder, and hard-problem-coder using direct Pi provider names plus completion_nudge steering. Full repo lint (671 files), tests (433 files / 2174 tests), and typecheck passed.

title: Honor minion role thinking metadata in child sessions
